sourceDesign.provenanceNote: Four approved references exported uncropped from the source Pencil document at 2x. adujr, s5TRC and xbIxj are the amendment request, corrected-result review and League correction history frames; CWJkF is the existing dispute frame re-used for dispute resolution (byte-identical to the PAF-8 export). The design file has no operator diagnostics frame: the diagnostics screens follow the product requirements and the existing app patterns, so they carry structural, accessibility and locale gates only.

adujr.png.certifies: Amendment request: authoritative confirmed result, reason, request action and authority note

s5TRC.png.certifies: Corrected result review: confirmed result still authoritative, proposed result, approve and reject

CWJkF.png.certifies: Community dispute resolution: disputed evidence, timeline and resolution choices (dark)

xbIxj.png.certifies: League history: audited correction of a closed final with the superseded final inspectable

visualBudgets.measurementMethod: Capture at reference pixelSize / 2 using Chromium deviceScaleFactor 1. Downsample only the uncropped 2x Pencil PNG. Compare same-size RGBA pixels with the pinned perceptual threshold (35215 x 0.1^2); reject any dimension mismatch before applying the per-screen budget.

perScreenRationale.adujr: Measured 0.1775. The match-detail route replaces the standalone request page: the correction card sits under the match header and the reason is entered in a Base UI dialog, so the reason box and the screen title differ by design. Probes pin the official-result banner, note and request action order, the 44px target, labelled dialog and error association.
perScreenRationale.s5TRC: Measured 0.1663. The corrected review lives in the match detail correction card (lifecycle banner, proposed result, approval progress, approve/reject) instead of a dedicated route; probes pin banner, proposed section and action order, 44px targets and the authoritative-result wording.
perScreenRationale.CWJkF: Measured 0.1888. Resolution choices open in a modal dialog over the match detail (three radio options, bounded justification, footer actions) rather than an inline list; probes pin option stacking, labelled field, associated error and dark-theme AA contrast.
perScreenRationale.xbIxj: Measured 0.1153. The League history screen keeps the existing standings table and version selector; the correction banner, supersedes line and view-prior action are added in the existing layout. Probes pin banner above the prior-version action, 44px target and no overflow.

visualBudgets.reason: Every screen has an exact-dimension production-flow capture and strict structural, accessibility and locale probes. Nonzero budgets are the measured residual plus a small raster margin (about 0.02); all stay below 0.25 and are never widened to mask a structural defect.
